text: Half the basic items I needed were completely unavailable. Wanted to make sambar tonight, but both toor dal and curry leaves were out of stock. Very frustrating.
Found every single pulse and brand of atta on my grocery list with zero shortages, and the rates are very pocket-friendly. Sadly, the palak and ladyfingers were rather wilted and unappealing.
Always fully stocked with kitchen staples and dairy! Got my whole monthly ration here—rice, poha, paneer—and saved at least Rs 400 compared to other stores.
Bought regular potatoes, onions, and garlic which were perfectly standard like any market produce. The prices here are unbeatable though, got 5kg chakki atta for just Rs 210!
The tomatoes and coriander leaves I ordered were completely squished and rotting inside. They arrived in ordinary brown paper bags, but that hardly helps when the produce is inedible.
Produce was alright. Bought carrots and capsicum, they were neither exceptionally fresh nor spoiled, just ordinary market quality.
Went through the counter and paid by UPI without any fuss. The cauliflower and beans were just standard veggies, but the discounts on daily staples are outstanding—saved nearly Rs 250 today!
The bhindi was terribly stringy and hard, and the ridge gourd had soft black spots all over. Really poor quality greens this week.
Outstanding experience! The delivery boy brought everything right to my door in 35 minutes, they had every single item including fresh paneer, and the green peas and mint were crisp and vibrant.
Prompt home delivery! The rider arrived right on time before dinner, even carrying the heavy 10kg flour bag straight up to my apartment.
They had some things I needed like milk and bread, while a couple of specific biscuit brands were missing. Pretty standard neighbourhood inventory.
Absolutely crisp spinach and sweet, ruby-red pomegranates! You can tell they source fresh morning harvest.

Veggies were wonderfully crisp and made a lovely meal, and prices were around the usual Rs 40 a bunch. But the billing counter was a nightmare—the barcode scanner broke down and we waited in queue for twenty minutes.
They carry every spice, pulse, and brand of butter you could ever look for. Unfortunately, the delivery was delayed by nearly three hours without any update from the store.
Great discounts on whatever they actually manage to carry, sunflower oil was Rs 25 cheaper than elsewhere. Too bad half the shelves were empty and there was no curd or bread left.
Paid with card at the counter, cashier handed me the receipt, standard billing process without issues.
The apples were bruised and mealy, and the mint leaves were already turning brown. The items came in standard plastic pouches, nothing special.
Dreadful produce. The bottle gourd smelled rancid and the ginger was soft and covered in white mold.
Super speedy home delivery! Handed over right at my door in under 25 minutes, everything carefully handled.
Very disappointed with the produce today. The bananas were overripe and split open, while the methi leaves were completely dried out.
Billing system was malfunctioning and the cashier was utterly untrained. Double charged my card for tea powder and took 15 minutes of arguing to reverse it.
Delivery person was polite and reached well within the promised 40-minute window.

Found most essentials like curd and milk, though they were out of one spice brand. The onions and lemons were just ordinary produce. What makes it worth coming back is the pricing—dal and sugar are noticeably cheaper here.
The cashier at the counter was quick and very polite, which was the only good part. The spinach was slimy and rotting, and charging Rs 90 for a tiny wilted cabbage is absolute daylight robbery.
Groceries arrived at my doorstep within an hour, nicely handled. Also very pleased with the rates, saved around Rs 150 on cleaning supplies and basmati rice.
Waited over three hours for my evening order of curd and bread, and the driver kept calling asking for landmark directions before abruptly cancelling.

The delivery boy arrived right on schedule within 25 minutes, which was great. However, their payment counter machine lagged and double-debited my UPI so I had to sort it out with bank support. The rates are pretty standard market rates, about ₹45 for a kilo of onions.

The spinach and coriander were crisp and super fresh, perfect for making palak paneer tonight. They had most basics though a couple of lentil varieties were unavailable while others were on the shelf.
Extremely disappointed. My order showed up nearly two hours late, and to make things worse, the tomatoes were squished and rotten inside the crate.
Loved the quality of the carrots, ladies finger, and Shimla mirch! Everything was crisp and dewy, felt straight from the farm.
Ordered my weekly staples yesterday and the package was dropped off at the door around 4 pm.
You cannot beat ₹30 a kilo for potatoes and genuine discount on cooking oil, great deals honestly. Too bad the cauliflower had black spots and the mint was completely wilted.

Their grocery rates are quite reasonable, but the execution was terrible. The green beans looked limp and dry, and they dumped heavy lentils straight onto the loose bananas inside a torn flimsy paper bag.

Produce like carrots and cucumbers were okay, neither particularly fresh nor bad. Very cheap prices across dairy and spices, but delivery was a nightmare—the driver showed up past 10 PM without any notification.
Very affordable grocery runs here, saved a good ₹200 on basic dal and ghee. But please improve the packaging; the milk pouch burst because it was not packed properly with the heavier tins.
Best place in the area for fresh greens! The methi was vibrant green and the apples were sweet and crunchy.
Crisp cucumbers and delicious Alphonso mangoes, top quality harvest. Sad that the delivery guy took three phone calls and almost an extra hour to find my apartment gate.
Vegetables are undeniably fresh and vibrant, especially the bell peppers and cabbage. Only wish home delivery was not delayed by 45 minutes when I had dinner prep waiting.
Fantastic service! The rider came in just 20 minutes, the tomatoes and bhindi were completely farm-fresh, and whole wheat flour cost less here than at the supermarket.
Super reasonable rates on daily staples like mustard oil, toor dal, and eggs. Found everything well below MRP.
The bananas were overripe with brown mush inside and the ridge gourd was rubbery. Paying at the counter with card went normally without delays.
They charged almost ₹80 for a tiny tub of curd and ₹120 for basic butter, completely overpriced compared to nearby stores. Half the usual items were in stock and half were not.

Billing counter was in total chaos this afternoon. The cashier took forever to scan bar codes and the system froze halfway through, leaving five of us waiting for 20 minutes.
Some brands of atta and basmati rice were available on the shelves, while a few regular spices were out of stock.

Loved how carefully each vegetable was separated in neat, breathable paper pouches so nothing got bruised. The brinjal and ladyfingers were very fresh, though inventory was a bit hit-or-miss with some spices missing.
Really impressed by the packaging! Glass jars of ghee were wrapped in thick corrugated cardboard and milk packets were packed in an insulated chilled pouch.

Tomatoes were squishy and the coriander was wilted by afternoon. Still, paying barely ₹25 a kilo makes it easy on the wallet.
Extremely pocket-friendly rates for everyday groceries, but the bhindi and methi leaves looked tired and brown at the edges.
Quick 25-minute delivery to my apartment, though disappointed that both curd tubs and paneer blocks were totally unavailable when ordering.

Crisp green capsicum and sweet Nagpur oranges at just ₹40 a kilo. Wonderful produce and very reasonable prices overall.
The Alphonso mangoes and bananas were absolutely top notch, sweet and without a single blemish!
Prices are pretty standard market rate around ₹65 for sugar, but they never seem to have mustard oil or poha whenever I place an order.
Cost is just average, nothing sensational. However, I was impressed with how carefully they bubble-wrapped the honey jar and eggs.

Standard billing counter experience, the card machine took a few tries but completed without major fuss.

Even though the cauliflower had dark spots and felt a bit limp, the bill was super low and delivery showed up at my door in just 20 minutes.

They always have every single grocery item I look for, from specific brands of basmati rice to cold-pressed gingelly oil.
